The Bright Side:
Reforming tactical policing units helps restore public trust during civic demonstrations.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing tactical unit restructuring with systemic police reform.

Activists and communities demanded accountability for aggressive protest policing, prompting political leadership to execute a structural shift away from specialized tactical units.

The Trajectory: The Path of Fall into Destruction.

The Unavoidable Lie: Disbanding one unit completely solves municipal public safety tensions.
